crossRefs.note: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to…
But he hasn’t called me, even me your servant, Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon.
So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down…

people.name: Benaiah
people.line: Son of Jehoiada, a mighty warrior and loyal supporter of David and Solomon.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jehoiada
people.line: Father of one of David's warriors, Benaiah

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

people.name: Zadok
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

translations.web: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.
translations.bsb: Then King David said, “Call in for me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.” So they came before the king.
translations.kjv: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
